statement: Keep an inventory entry, with a named owner, for every AI system used in credit decisions.
Watch the performance of the AI system used for credit decisions and fraud scoring after release and act on drift.
Make sure a person can review, challenge and override the output of the system used for customer chat and the internal copilot.
Have a written plan to respond to a failure or harmful output of the system used for fraud scoring.
Retire the system used for document summaries in an orderly way and keep its records.
Approve changes to the system used for fraud scoring before they reach production.
